finalText:
All objectives verified. Final report:

**Objective 1 — DONE.** Ticket created with title `fwrd54-n1 RD Bench Ticket`, reference **RD-1015**, customer "Bench Customer", initial status Draft, created 2026-09-15.

**Objective 2 — DONE.** Part `fwrd54-n1 RD Part A` added with cost $100.00 and markup 25%. App-computed price: **$125.00** (footer total $125.00).

**Objective 3 — DONE.** Part `fwrd54-n1 RD Part B` added with cost $200.00 and markup 25%. App-computed price: **$250.00** (footer total then $375.00).

**Objective 4 — DONE.** Part A's cost edited from 100 to 150 (markup unchanged at 25%). App-computed price afterwards: **$187.50** (footer total $437.50; Part B unchanged at $250.00).

**Objective 5 — DONE.** The app refused "Mark Ready" while parts had no supplier, showing the alert: "Ticket is not ready / Part "fwrd54-n1 RD Part A" has no supplier / Part "fwrd54-n1 RD Part B" has no supplier". **Required precondition: every part on the ticket must have a supplier.** I satisfied it by editing both parts and setting Supplier = "Acme Parts" (free-text field; costs/markups unchanged). "Mark Ready" then succeeded with no error — Status displayed **Ready**, and the toolbar switched to Mark Draft / Mark Closed.

**Objective 6 — DONE.** Both parts deleted (each via Delete → in-page "Confirm" modal → "Delete part"; parts table then read "No parts on this ticket yet.").
